key_catalyst: Escalating U.S.-Iran Geopolitical Tensions and Oil Price Surge
reasoning: The U.S. has conducted nine consecutive nights of strikes on Iran, pushing Brent crude above $90 with no ceasefire agreement in place, representing a severe and escalating geopolitical threat. Although the market is attempting a pre-market bounce on ceasefire hopes, the ongoing military escalation and surging oil prices pose an unresolved risk to tech and risk assets.
